lead.event: Ultra Jaya plans a rights issue to acquire Frisian Flag Indonesia
lead.headline: ULTJ plans Rp16.94 trillion rights issue to acquire Frisian Flag Indonesia
lead.blurb: The plan covers 7.88 billion new shares at Rp2,150 each, with 86.01% of proceeds earmarked for the acquisition through a Rp14.57 trillion non-cash contribution and the balance for working capital. FCIH would acquire 100% of Frisian Flag Indonesia and become ULTJ’s controlling shareholder, replacing Sabana Prawiridjaja. Management projects a 137% annual income boost from FFI and expects net cash flow to increase by 30.12% to 42.32%. The cum-rights date is 8 January 2027.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: Management expects net cash flow to increase by 30.12% to 42.32%.

deals_control.event: Controlling-shareholder shares in Alamtri and Adaro Andalan change hands
deals_control.headline: ADRO and AADI controlling-shareholder shares worth Rp66.81 trillion change hands
deals_control.blurb: Saratoga disclosed it invested Rp17.5 trillion, buying 838.45 million AADI shares from Adaro Strategic Investments for Rp8.62 trillion and 3.68 billion ADRO shares for Rp8.87 trillion. The purchases give Saratoga direct benefits from both companies rather than an indirect interest through Adaro Strategic Investments, while ADRO said control was unchanged.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

deals_control.event: Garuda Indonesia prepares its third rights issue with Danantara participation
deals_control.headline: GIAA plans 248.71 billion-share rights issue and is expected to control GMFI
deals_control.blurb: Garuda plans to issue up to 248.71 billion new shares at Rp58 to Rp68 each, with potential dilution of up to 37.92% for shareholders who do not participate. Danantara Asset Management will exercise its rights by contributing 82.1 billion GMFI shares. Shareholders on the register at 16:15 WIB on 23 December will qualify, with trading and exercise scheduled from 29 December to 7 January.

deals_control.event: Shima Global Kapital increases its stake in Energi Mega Persada
deals_control.headline: ENRG shareholder Shima Global Kapital raises stake to 17.46%
deals_control.blurb: Shima Global Kapital bought 2.33 billion ENRG shares on 6 November for about Rp1.28 trillion. The purchase was intended for internal consolidation into Bakrie Kalila Investment, part of Grup Bakrie, ahead of the MSCI Small Cap Index rebalancing scheduled for 11 November.

deals_control.event: Menteng Heritage Realty shareholders sign a share purchase agreement
deals_control.headline: HRME shareholders sign share purchase agreement as shares rise 34.15%
deals_control.blurb: Menteng Heritage Realty said Wijaya Wisesa Realty and Twin Investment signed with Properti International Development as prospective buyer on 9 November. The proposed transfer remains subject to due diligence, and its share count and value have not been disclosed.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Indo Tambangraya conducts a Rp1.83 trillion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: ITMG conducts Rp1.83 trillion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: From January to early November 2026, Indo Tambangraya bought 54.82 million shares, equal to 4.9% of its outstanding shares. It has announced a further Rp2.31 trillion buyback, scheduled to conclude in February 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: Sido Muncul reports nine-month results and a third-quarter recovery
earnings_guidance.headline: SIDO reports nine-month results and Q3 recovery, projects 10% 2026 revenue decline
earnings_guidance.blurb: Sido Muncul's Q3 sales distribution ratio to end consumers improved to 94%, and analysts said the worst of distributor inventory adjustment had passed. Management cited El Nino and consumer purchasing power as risks behind its 2026 outlook.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

earnings_guidance.event: Indonesia’s four largest banks report declining net interest margins in 9M26
earnings_guidance.headline: Indonesia’s largest banks report 9M26 NIM shifts as BMRI falls to 4.21%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Mandiri’s margin fell from 4.59%, while BCA’s declined to 5.41% from 5.76% and BRI’s to 6.16% from 6.53%. BNI’s rose to 3.76% from 3.47%. The banks are focusing on productive lending and low-cost funds, and Bank Mandiri cut its full-year NIM target to 4.3%–4.5% from 4.5%–4.7%.

earnings_guidance.event: BRI Danareksa raises its target price for Astra International
earnings_guidance.headline: BRI Danareksa raises ASII target price to Rp6,950 from Rp6,850
earnings_guidance.blurb: BRI Danareksa analyst Erindra Krisnawan projects Astra International's 2026 net profit at Rp29.14 trillion, 5.3% above the prior estimate, and maintains a buy recommendation. He cites recovering automotive profitability and stable financial services contributions, with UNTR expected to remain a key profit driver through Q4-2026 and 2027.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

earnings_guidance.event: Telkom reports lower nine-month profit amid investment losses
earnings_guidance.headline: TLKM reports nearly 4% nine-month profit decline to Rp14.45 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Telkom said unrealized gains and losses totaling Rp1.66 trillion heavily influenced the decline, including losses of Rp759 billion on Telkomsel's GOTO investment and Rp794 billion at MDI Ventures. Operating income rose 3.54% to Rp113.5 trillion, but higher operating and administrative costs offset the increase.

other.event: RANS government influencer contracts face ICW and BEI scrutiny
other.headline: RANS faces scrutiny over Rp14.7 billion in government influencer contracts
other.blurb: Rans Entertainment's subsidiary received one Rp3.9 billion campaign and three Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries campaigns worth Rp10.8 billion, covering 2024–2026. The company said the contracts followed procurement procedures through Inaproc and e-Katalog, while BEI reviews them. RANS closed at Rp94 on 11 November, down 45.7% from 12 October.

macro_flows.event: Bank Indonesia reports October consumer confidence and spending data
macro_flows.headline: BI reports October consumer confidence index at 119.9 as consumption share falls
macro_flows.blurb: The average share of consumer income allocated to consumption fell to 73.6%, while savings rose to 16.4%. Household consumption grew 5.04% year on year in Q3 2026.
